column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name rather than by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset: the run reports exactly the /mysql and /mssql arms. Guards cleat#1153 groundwork -- a child in a terminal status must stop counting against its parent's child-workflow quota. The arms have to exist even where they skip, because GetChildCount is a SEPARATE hand-written statement in engine/store_children.go, engine/mysql_ops.go and engine/mssql_signals_promises.go, and all three carried the same omission ('terminated' missing) independently -- so a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two. Falsification confirms it: restoring the omission fails all three subtests independently.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too, so these two lines move together -- scripts/skip-ledger.d/README.md says so, and updating only one costs a second CI round trip (it cost me one on #1550). Same measurement and same reason as the test-go/engine line above; see cleat#1153.
